Prompt engineering gets you a good demo. It doesn't get you a reliable AI application.

The real progression looks like this: Prompt Engineering → Context Engineering → Harness Engineering → Loop Engineering.

Each stage exists because the one before it wasn't enough on its own — a good prompt without the right context stalls, good context without a harness is unsafe to act on, and a harness without a loop can't handle multi-step work.

I wrote up the four stages with a practical example: an AI agent fixing a failed data pipeline, walked through at each stage of maturity.
